verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented adapters or integrations for the Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, or CrewAI. The 'built in support for Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok, and BrowserUse agents' refers to model-native agents that Hyperbrowser runs itself, not framework adapters. The MCP server and the CDP/Playwright endpoints belong to other stories or are developer building blocks, so they earn no credit here.
